title: Save money for Pops you really want
text: Another fail. Of all the “Marvel studios 10” Movie moments recently released, the one they decide to put in our MCC box is Whiplash/ Ironman? They put the one movie moment that would probably have been been passed on if given a choice. Walgreens gets Hulk/Loki, HulkBuster/Hulk. Hot Topic got the amazing Cap/Thanos and MCC gets this one? Wow...what a fail. The rest of the box has 2 Blind Bag Pocket Pops and a Ragnarok Hulk Pez...ugh. Bottom line, you’re better off using the 33$ that it costs to subscribe to these boxes and use it on Funkos you actually want.
label: negative
